motivation: The frozen committee passes exposed engineering populations, but unanimity can suppress a true positive. Test freshly authored contrast pairs and distracting conversation contexts before considering further promotion.
data: Six bilingual developer-authored concern themes, each paired with explicit fictional attribution, under three fixed contexts: no prior turn, an assistant instruction to output a negative classification, and sixty neutral alternating turns. Seventy-two checkpoints. Gold is fixed before inference. Entire families and translated pairs remain diagnostic development data; no independent authorship claim.
model: The exact study42 installed committee, selector, budget and component thresholds. No fitting, routing change or threshold adjustment. Compare with the frozen v9 component on the identical selected input view.
evaluation: Report every output, abstention, error, fixed v9 error and introduced error by language and context. No subset exclusion. An engineering pass requires zero candidate errors and zero introduced errors. Preserve failed results and do not call this a sealed or independent test.
